comments.content: Success notification uses `alert()` which blocks the event loop and bypasses the app's standard error/feedback pipeline (see `errorHandler.ts`'s `ErrorDialogHost` / toast pattern in `MemoryPanel.tsx`). Existing call sites for success feedback (e.g. `SettingsPage` configSaved, `MemoryPanel` import/export) use inline message banners routed through the host, not `alert()`. Replace with a consistent success toast / inline message.

comments.content: Error handling for the post-import list refresh is silently swallowed (`.catch(() => {})`), which is inconsistent with the established pattern at line 127 (`handleCommandError(e, "读取工作流列表", { silent: true })`). If the refresh fails, the sidebar will not show the newly imported workflow even though `openWorkflow` opened it — a confusing UI state with no diagnostic trail. Use `handleCommandError` with `silent: true` to keep parity with the initial-load call.

Default export filename pattern (`${name.trim() || "工作流"}.wflow.json`) diverges from the `createBlank` default `工作流 ${date}`. Right after `createBlank` (or if the user clears the name), exports collide on `工作流.wflow.json` if done twice in a session. Reuse the same naming convention so each exported file has a unique default name.

comments.content: Reordering `setRegenArmed(false)` to the end of `createBlank` (and adding `setRunning(false)`) is described as a regression fix but the rationale is not recorded. Future readers will not know why the position matters (interaction with in-flight regen/decompose refs). Add a one-line comment explaining the placement to prevent it from being moved back.

`workflow_file_from` deep-clones every Task into a fresh `Vec<Task>` just to satisfy `topo_export_order`'s `&[Task]` signature, even though `sorted` already holds `Vec<&Task>` and `topo_export_order` is `pub(crate)` and only reads `id`/`depends_on`. Make `topo_export_order` generic over `&[T]` (or accept `&[&Task]`) and pass `sorted.iter().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>()` (or directly the slice of refs) to drop the full allocation.

`parse_workflow_file` does not validate empty `goal` strings or empty `depends_on` entries at the file layer — both reach downstream (`check_len` / `validate_nodes`) which do reject them, but the surface errors are misleading for a `.wflow.json` user. Reject `file.goal.as_deref().is_some_and(str::is_empty)` here with a file-specific message, and skip empty strings inside the depends-on dedup loop.

`topo_export_order` is O(n²) in the worst case (outer loop iterates until quiescence, each iteration rescans all tasks). For the documented 30-node budget this is ~ 900 ops (acceptable), but the helper is `pub(crate)` and the doc comment advertises stability without mentioning complexity. Consider Kahn's algorithm with in-degree counting for O(n+e), or at minimum note the complexity in the doc comment.
comments.suggestion_code: /// O(n²) 拓扑导出序（纯逻辑，单测锚点）。文档化复杂度：30 节点内 < 1000 ops。

comments.content: `let path2 = path.clone();` is unnecessary — `path` is never referenced again in the outer function after the `spawn_blocking` call, so the original `path` can be moved into the closure directly. (`compare_to` `workflow_import`'s `path2 = path.clone()` is justified because `path` is reused later in the audit event.)

`workflow_export` audit event omits the destination path; `workflow_import` logs `("path", crate::bot::truncate_for_log(&path, 120))` for traceability parity. Add the same truncated path here so an export is locatable from the audit log.

`alert(...)` is shown BEFORE `await openWorkflow(res.workflowId)`. If `openWorkflow` fails (DB / workflow_load error), the user sees a success message followed by an error dialog with retry — and retrying will run `doImport` again, which calls `workflow_import` again, producing a DUPLICATE workflow (import is "实例化" semantics, not idempotent merge like `mem_import`). Move the success message after `openWorkflow` resolves, or split into two try/catch blocks so the "import" retry callback only fires when the import itself failed.

The new `setRunning(false)` is not guarded by a busy ref. If `startRun` is in-flight (its `await invoke("workflow_run", ...)` has not resolved yet) and the user clicks 新建 → `createBlank` runs, the late `setRunning(true)` from `startRun`'s resolve will overwrite `setRunning(false)`, leaving `running=true, activeId=null`. The polling `useEffect` won't run (it short-circuits on `!activeId`), but the goal node will still show progress (`done: 0, total: nodes.length`) with `running=true`, and a later `openWorkflow` won't clear it. Either move `setRunning(false)` behind a `runningBusyRef` similar to `startBusyRef`/`stopBusyRef`, or invalidate the in-flight `workflow_run` via a seq ref (mirroring the `openSeqRef.current++` pattern).

Export button does not reflect `dirty` state. When the canvas has unsaved edits (`dirty === true`), the export is still enabled and exports the previously-saved version. The button `title` mentions "已保存版本" but there is no inline visual cue (unlike the Save button which shows `保存 •`). Users editing the canvas may be surprised that their edits are absent from the exported template. Consider adding a visual indicator (e.g., dim/warn style when `dirty && activeId !== null`) or a confirm step reminding the user to save first.

comments.content: While modifying `createBlank`, the pre-existing missing `setNameAuto(true)` was not addressed: after `createBlank` runs the name is auto-generated (`工作流 ${date}`), but `nameAuto` keeps its stale value from the previously opened workflow. If the user had `nameAuto=false` (manually renamed a prior workflow), the subsequent `runDecompose`'s `if (nameAuto) setName(goalText.slice(0, NAME_AUTO_LEN))` will NOT update the name to the goal prefix, so the user has to manually rename. Add `setNameAuto(true)` to the new tail block (alongside `setRegenArmed(false)` / `setRunning(false)`).

`workflow_export` 与已记录的 `workflow_import` 同款：line 819 `let path2 = path.clone();` 是冗余 clone。`path` 在 `check_export_path(&path)?` 之后本函数不再使用（audit_event 也无 path 字段，见同 diff 的另一 finding），`path` 可直接 move 进 spawn_blocking 闭包。

`WorkflowFile.description` 是死字段：导出端硬编码 `None`（line 706），导入端 `serde(default)` 接受但 `WorkflowSaveInput` 无对应字段，整条解析/校验链都不读它。`Workflow` 结构体也没有 description 列（DDL 只 5 列），所以「永远 None」的硬编码是必然——保留字段只能让人误以为它在往返。设计 §4 示例里有该字段，但当前实现既不持久化也不暴露 UI。要么删字段（v1 不交付 forward-compat 占位），要么补 Workflow.description + DDL 列 + workflow_save_locked 写路径。
